mapper.select: /* SQL ID : DscsFdbkDAO.selectFdbk 설명 : 피드백 조회 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY REG_DTTM) AS LINE_NO , COUNT(DSCS_FDBK_ID) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT , DSCS_FDBK_ID AS dscsFdbkId , UP_DSCS_FDBK_ID AS upDscsFdbkId , DSCS_ID AS dscsId , USER_ID AS stdId , TEAM_ID AS teamId , DSCS_FDBK_CTS AS dscsFdbkCts , DELYN , (SELECT USERNM FROM TB_LMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.USER_ID) AS RGTRNM , RGTR_ID , REG_DTTM , MDFR_ID , MOD_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_FDBK A WHERE DSCS_ID = #{dscsId} AND USER_ID = #{stdId} AND DELYN = 'N' ORDER BY REG_DTTM DESC
